stories.summary: Tata Motors sold 649,477 passenger vehicles between January and October 2026, surpassing its total 2025 volume of 573,007 units. stories.title: India plans world's highest railway station in Ladakh
stories.summary: India is proposing a 489-km railway corridor connecting Bilaspur and Leh at an estimated cost of 1.31 lakh crore. The project aims to feature a station at 5,256 metres above sea level, which would surpass China's current record for the world's highest railway station.

stories.title: One in three car buyers still deciding this festive season
stories.summary: A Grant Thornton Bharat survey found that 32.9 percent of consumers are still weighing car purchases this festive season. While 24.9 percent identified as likely or definite buyers, others remain focused on ownership costs, fuel technology, and features. Hybrid vehicles currently remain the preferred powertrain choice for those interested.

stories.title: Indian car buyers pivot to CNG and EVs
stories.summary: Indian consumers are increasingly prioritizing features and operating costs over traditional price points, according to Deloitte India. The market is shifting toward higher-priced models, with growing demand for CNG and electric vehicles. SUVs continue to reshape price segments as ownership patterns evolve across the country.

stories.summary: Blinkit will charge 2,500 rupees for non-emergency ambulance transfers, while maintaining free service for emergencies. Vice chairman Deepinder Goyal stated the fee aims to reduce routine bookings for hospital visits and home transfers, noting that private transport could handle such trips just as easily as a medical response service.

stories.title: Government expands farmer e-commerce model to post offices
stories.summary: The agriculture ministry plans to turn post offices into dark stores to help farmer producer organizations ship produce directly to consumers. Following pilots in Gujarat, Tamil Nadu, and Madhya Pradesh, the initiative will expand to Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, and Maharashtra to reduce reliance on intermediaries and bulk buyers.

stories.title: AI expected to reshape India's office space demand
stories.summary: A Cushman and Wakefield study projects India's office-using workforce will grow from 38 million in 2025 to 48 million by 2030. Researchers suggest AI will change the nature of office demand rather than reduce it, as Global Capability Centres shift toward higher-value activities requiring human oversight.

stories.summary: Honda Cars India sold 7,609 domestic units in October 2026, a 19 percent increase over the same month last year. stories.title: Toyota launches Innova Crysta Limo Edition for fleets
stories.summary: Toyota Kirloskar Motor has introduced the Innova Crysta Limo Edition, priced at 19.95 lakh rupees. stories.summary: Toyota has launched the Innova Crysta Limo Edition to provide a dedicated identity for its commercial mobility segment. Available in 7-seater and 8-seater configurations, the vehicle retains the standard 2.4-litre diesel engine. stories.title: BYD to launch second-generation Seal 07 in China
stories.summary: BYD will launch its second-generation Seal 07 sedan in China on November 5, just eight months after the previous model. stories.summary: Hyundai has trademarked the Ioniq P nameplate in India. The sub-4-metre electric vehicle is expected to launch in January 2027 with Level 2 ADAS and a mid-nickel NMC battery pack. The Ioniq branding follows the company's previous electric vehicle releases in the Indian market.

stories.summary: Ducati has launched the Desmo450 EDX and MX Factory in India, priced at Rs 18.55 lakh and Rs 21.26 lakh respectively. Both models use a 449.6cc single-cylinder engine. The EDX is intended for enduro riding, while the MX Factory is focused on motocross performance.

stories.title: Two-wheeler sales rise 16 percent in October
stories.summary: India's six major two-wheeler manufacturers reported a combined sales increase of 16.45 percent year-on-year, reaching 29.21 lakh units in October 2026. Hero MotoCorp led domestic sales with 7.05 lakh units. Honda finished just 163 units ahead of Hero in total cumulative volumes for the month.

stories.title: Altigreen launches Minsara electric two-wheeler
stories.summary: Altigreen has launched the Minsara, a multi-utility electric two-wheeler intended for urban and rural commercial use. The vehicle is available in three variants with claimed ranges of up to 165 km. It is designed for farmers, traders, and fleet operators who require a vehicle for daily work.

stories.title: UK electric car registrations rise 33 percent
stories.summary: UK electric car registrations rose 32.7 percent year-on-year in October 2026, with 48,858 battery electric vehicles registered. Fully electric models accounted for 32 percent of all new car registrations for the month. Demand continues to grow, though the pace remains a matter of industry tracking.

stories.title: Renault unveils robotic military vehicle
stories.summary: Renault has partnered with John Cockerill to reveal the Forefront Concept, a cab-less, all-electric robotic platform for military and civilian use. The vehicle is designed for remote operation or autonomous navigation. It combines silent propulsion with off-road performance, removing the need for a driver to be present.

stories.title: India EV registrations grow as car sales decline
stories.summary: India's electric vehicle market recorded 74.7 percent year-on-year growth in October 2026, with 36,646 units registered. This occurred while overall passenger vehicle registrations fell 14.6 percent. Tata Motors held a 40.7 percent share of electric car sales, while Mahindra accounted for 23.7 percent.

stories.title: VinFast aims for Indian SUV market
stories.summary: VinFast is bringing its VF 7 electric SUV to India, citing Italian design and aerospace-inspired details as key differentiators. The company aims to carve out a niche in a market that has traditionally prioritised road presence and practicality. Style is now a performance metric.

stories.title: Mercedes-Benz launches GLC 400 4MATIC in India
stories.summary: Mercedes-Benz has launched its locally assembled GLC 400 4MATIC electric SUV in India for 78.5 lakh rupees. The vehicle features a dual-motor powertrain and a 94 kWh battery with a claimed range of 711 km. It is built on a dedicated electric platform.

stories.title: Vauxhall hits 100,000 electric vehicle sales in UK
stories.summary: Vauxhall has sold more than 102,800 fully electric vehicles in the UK, reaching a milestone the company calls a major achievement in its electrification strategy. The 100,000th unit sold was a Grandland Electric. The brand continues to focus on pricing and charging infrastructure.

stories.title: Electric cars take one third of UK market
stories.summary: Electric vehicles accounted for one in three new car registrations in the UK during October, according to the SMMT. Sales rose by a third compared to the same month last year, with nearly 50,000 units sold. Petrol and diesel sales continue to decline.

stories.title: UK new car sales rise in October
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. Global Banking and Finance Review reports that UK new car sales increased by 5.4 percent in October 2026, with battery electric vehicle market share reaching a record high.

stories.title: Australian electric vehicle sales outpace petrol
stories.summary: Battery electric vehicles outsold petrol-only cars in Australia for the third consecutive month in October, recording 24,845 sales. Tesla delivered 4,050 vehicles, a 342 percent increase over the previous year. Plugs are becoming the standard.

stories.title: Mercedes-Benz GLC Electric sold out until 2027
stories.summary: Mercedes-Benz has launched the GLC 400 4MATIC in India for 78.50 lakh rupees. The company reports over 1,000 bookings for the locally assembled SUV, with production capacity reportedly sold out until March 2027. Demand has arrived ahead of the cars.

stories.title: Festive demand boosts Indian truck rentals
stories.summary: Truck rentals increased across major Indian routes in October, supported by festive-season freight movement. According to the Shriram Mobility Bulletin, two-wheeler and passenger car sales also recorded month-on-month growth. The season has arrived for the transport sector.

stories.title: Tata Motors and Iveco Group form commercial vehicle alliance
stories.summary: Tata Motors and Iveco Group have launched a global commercial mobility enterprise, creating the world's fourth-largest commercial vehicle manufacturer. The combined entity generates over 21 billion euros in annual revenue. The alliance spans 130 countries across Europe, India and South America.

stories.title: Auto stocks rally as oil prices fall
stories.summary: Shares of Tata Motors and Ashok Leyland rallied up to 8 percent following a 10 percent drop in Brent crude oil prices to 94 dollars. Maruti Suzuki and Mahindra and Mahindra also saw gains. Markets remain sensitive to the cost of fuel.

stories.title: Nomura maintains target price for Tata Motors CV
stories.summary: Nomura has maintained a 511 rupee target price for Tata Motors Commercial Vehicles, citing internal potential for improvement. The firm noted a challenging demand environment and weak performance at subsidiary Iveco. Execution remains the focus.

stories.title: Affordable off-roaders in India
stories.summary: Mass-market brands including Maruti Suzuki, Mahindra and Force offer SUVs featuring ladder-frame construction and four-wheel drive. stories.summary: Infineon has launched the AURIX RC1, its first microcontroller platform using the RISC-V instruction set architecture. stories.summary: AGC Inc. has revised its full-year operating profit outlook down by 30 billion yen to 120 billion yen. The company cited drag from its automotive and architectural glass divisions. Net profit attributable to owners was also cut by 37 billion yen, down to 40 billion yen.

stories.summary: Pzena Investment Management grew its stake in Advance Auto Parts by 13.6 percent in the third quarter. stories.summary: ASK Automotive reported record revenue and EBITDA for the second quarter, growing 47.5 percent and 30.2 percent respectively. stories.summary: Toyota has raised its fiscal year 2027 operating income forecast to 3.9 trillion yen. The company lowered its total retail sales projection from 11.18 million to 10.99 million units. stories.summary: Ahead of Diwali, Axis Bank has introduced festive retail banking offers including car loans with 100 percent financing and 30-minute disbursal times. The company operates 17 plants and maintains supply ties with manufacturers including Bajaj Auto and Jaguar Land Rover. It reports using over 700 robots and mistake-proofing systems to manage its production lines.

stories.summary: LG Electronics India reported a 27 percent year-on-year increase in net profit to 489 crore rupees for the second quarter. Revenue rose 19.5 percent to 7,380 crore rupees, with home appliances serving as the primary driver. Shares rose nearly 5 percent following the announcement.

stories.summary: Aptus Value Housing Finance reported 20 percent year-on-year growth in assets under management, crossing 14,000 crore rupees. Profit grew 18 percent to 267 crore rupees. stories.title: LG Electronics India enters automotive electronics market
stories.summary: LG Electronics India is expanding into the automotive sector, focusing on infotainment and telematics. The new division will manufacture digital cockpits, displays, and safety technologies. The company is looking to diversify its business beyond its established consumer electronics and home appliance segments.

stories.title: Automotive customer experience study notes AI gap
stories.summary: A report from Percepta and Ryan Strategic Advisory identifies a growing gap between consumer demand for AI and stagnant customer service performance in the automotive industry. The study, based on 815 respondents, highlights a need for better employee development alongside new technology integration.

stories.title: Toyota and Waymo partner on autonomous taxis
stories.summary: Toyota is partnering with Waymo to advance its dual-track strategy in self-driving vehicles. The collaboration aims to address the industry-wide shift toward software-defined vehicles and autonomous driving. The full details of the agreement are available to subscribers of the publication.

stories.title: The risks of the connected vehicle
stories.summary: Modern vehicles now function as high-performance computers, integrating cloud-based navigation and driver-assistance systems. This connectivity introduces new vulnerabilities, as demonstrated by the potential for cyberattacks to override manual steering and braking inputs. The car is essentially a computer on wheels, with all the associated security risks.

stories.title: AI accelerates cyber threats for global companies
stories.summary: Companies are reporting a surge in sophisticated cyberattacks, with executives citing AI as a primary driver of the increased threat level. IT departments are struggling to patch vulnerabilities, leading to higher investment in AI-powered security tools. Hackers have recently targeted supermarket refrigeration systems to cause food spoilage.

stories.title: Qualcomm reports record automotive revenue
stories.summary: Qualcomm reported fourth-quarter non-GAAP revenue of $10.4 billion, reaching the high end of its guidance. Automotive revenue reached $2 billion for the first time, an 89 percent increase year-over-year. Handset revenue remained flat, reflecting broader trends in the global smartphone market.

stories.title: GM discusses AI and software-defined vehicles
stories.summary: General Motors participated in the FISITA World Mobility Summit to discuss the future of software-defined vehicles and artificial intelligence. The company highlighted the role of human judgment in mobility innovation and demonstrated new virtual vehicle development technology. The summit gathered global automotive executives and R&D leaders.

stories.title: EU lawmakers consider security threat from BYD
stories.summary: European Union lawmakers are pushing for an assessment of potential security threats posed by vehicles manufactured by BYD. The request comes as the bloc evaluates the risks associated with connected car technology. Access to the full report on the legislative push is restricted.

stories.title: Electric vehicle parking fees return
stories.summary: Local council car parks have ended free parking privileges for electric vehicle drivers. The change marks a shift in policy for municipal charging and parking incentives. Further details regarding the council decision are currently unavailable due to site access restrictions.

stories.title: Report warns of automotive competitiveness gap
stories.summary: A new LSE Consulting report warns that the European automotive industry faces mounting pressure from global competition and rising costs. The study calls for deeper EU and UK cooperation on battery supply chains and trade rules to safeguard a sector that employs 1.37 million people.

stories.title: Louisville business marks anniversary of UPS crash
stories.summary: A local business owner is reflecting on the one-year anniversary of a UPS crash that impacted their property. The site served as the focal point for the incident in Louisville. Further information regarding the anniversary is restricted by site security settings.

stories.title: Democrats to challenge Trump auto agenda
stories.summary: Democrats in Congress are preparing to challenge the incoming administration's auto policy agenda. While the party holds the legislative power to contest specific regulations, analysts suggest that reversing established policies will be difficult. Full coverage of the political outlook is available to subscribers.

stories.title: Canadian auto industry eyes tariff relief
stories.summary: The Canadian automotive sector is looking for potential shifts in trade policy following recent midterm election results. Industry stakeholders are monitoring the possibility of changes to proposed tariffs. Access to the full report on the impact of the election is currently restricted.

stories.title: Jhabakh and Sherif win Asia Pacific Rally Championship
stories.summary: Jeet Jhabakh and Musa Sherif have won the 2026 Asia Pacific Rally Championship, marking the first time an all-Indian pairing has taken the title. Jhabakh is the first driver to win the championship in a two-wheel-drive car. He finished 35 points ahead of his nearest rival.

stories.title: Arvid Lindblad celebrates heritage at Sao Paulo GP
stories.summary: Formula One driver Arvid Lindblad is wearing a custom helmet for the Sao Paulo Grand Prix to celebrate Diwali. Born to a Swedish father and a mother of Punjabi roots, the British-licensed teen displays the flags of all three nations. He is currently chasing a career in F1.

stories.title: Sao Paulo F1 broadcast information
stories.summary: Information regarding the broadcast schedule and viewing platforms for the 2026 Sao Paulo Grand Prix is available through official channels. The website hosting the details is currently employing security measures that may restrict access for some users.

stories.title: F1 champion Alan Jones dies at 80
stories.summary: Alan Jones, Australia's second Formula One world champion, has died at age 80. Jones secured the 1980 drivers' title with the Williams team, winning five races that season. He remains the last Australian to win the world championship, having achieved 12 career race victories.

stories.title: Five drivers contend for NASCAR series title
stories.summary: Justin Allgaier enters the final race as the points leader for the O'Reilly Auto Parts Series championship. He faces competition from four other drivers, including reigning champion Jesse Love, who sits 22 points behind. The title will be decided at the upcoming event at Homestead.

stories.title: Nemechek to join Haas Factory Team in 2027
stories.summary: John Hunter Nemechek will move to the Haas Factory Team for the 2027 NASCAR season. The 29-year-old will drive the No. 41 Chevrolet with sponsorship from Pye-Barker Fire and Safety. Nemechek is currently driving for Legacy Motor Club, which will see a driver change next year.

stories.title: Ford reports revenue decline and profit growth
stories.summary: Ford reported a 2 percent year-over-year revenue decline to $49.5 billion for the third quarter. Despite the drop in sales, adjusted EBIT increased 3 percent to $2.7 billion. The company attributed the profit growth to factors beyond the total number of vehicles sold.

stories.title: John Hunter Nemechek returns to Haas Factory Team
stories.summary: John Hunter Nemechek will drive the No. 41 Chevrolet for Haas Factory Team in the 2027 NASCAR O’Reilly Auto Parts Series. The move reunites the driver with a series where he has 11 career victories. The team enters the season with championship expectations for the second-generation driver.

stories.title: Croatia launches 20 million euro electric vehicle subsidy
stories.summary: Croatia has opened a 20 million euro subsidy scheme to encourage electric vehicle purchases. The Environmental Protection and Energy Efficiency Fund began accepting applications on 5 November. The programme aims to increase the share of energy-efficient vehicles on the road and reduce transport emissions.

stories.title: Egypt plans to produce 100,000 electric vehicles by 2032
stories.summary: Egypt is developing domestic production of batteries, electric motors and vehicle components to support an electric vehicle industry. The government aims to produce 100,000 vehicles annually by 2032 to reduce import reliance. Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly recently reviewed the strategy to localize automotive manufacturing.

stories.title: CATL, Ampace and Octopus Energy partner on home batteries
stories.summary: CATL, Ampace and Octopus Energy have signed a memorandum of understanding to develop home energy storage for European households. The partnership aims to combine battery technology with digital energy management software. The companies claim the collaboration could make residential batteries more affordable and efficient for consumers.

stories.title: Electric vehicle batteries as grid backup
stories.summary: Electric vehicle batteries provide backup power and store renewable energy. A typical electric vehicle stores about 74 kWh of energy, which is over five times the capacity of a Tesla Powerwall. Cars sit parked roughly 95 percent of the time, according to the report.

stories.title: 3D printing joins New Mexico Electric Car Challenge
stories.summary: Middle school students in New Mexico are incorporating 3D-printed parts into their electric car designs for this year's competition. Sponsored by Sandia National Laboratories, the event focuses on engineering and design. Teachers recently attended a workshop at the Center for Advanced Manufacturing and Innovation to learn about prototyping.

stories.title: Toyota profit jumps 34 percent on hybrid demand
stories.summary: Toyota reported a 34 percent increase in quarterly operating profit to 1.13 trillion yen. The company cited strong hybrid sales in the United States as the primary driver for the recovery. Shares jumped 17 percent on 5 November, marking the company's largest one-day move since 1987.

stories.title: Nio schedules tech day after delivery decline
stories.summary: Nio will hold an innovation day on 25 November to showcase AI-driven cockpits and assisted driving products. The event follows a 15.23 percent drop in October vehicle deliveries. The company aims to highlight its shift into an AI-native organization after 31 months of year-on-year expansion ended.

stories.title: Australian electric vehicle sales reach 23 percent market share
stories.summary: New vehicle sales in Australia rose 3.8 percent in October to 103,325 units. Battery electric vehicles accounted for 23.1 percent of the market, nearly triple the share from October 2025. The Federal Chamber of Automotive Industries attributed the growth to wider model availability and government tax concessions.

stories.title: UK new car market grows as electric vehicle uptake rises
stories.summary: UK new car registrations grew 5.4 percent in October, marking the 11th consecutive month of growth. Battery electric vehicles reached a 32 percent monthly market share, their highest of 2026. Fleet registrations accounted for 58.9 percent of the market, while private demand rose 4.1 percent.

stories.title: Chinese car brands see rapid growth in UK market
stories.summary: Chinese brands saw significant sales growth in October, with Jaecoo up 114 percent and Chery up 194 percent. Meanwhile, established brands like Tesla and Ford saw sales decline by 45 percent and 35 percent respectively. GWM sold two cars. The government is currently weighing tariffs on EV imports.
